name: Taqueria Quesadilla Sencilla (Flour Tortilla & Melted Monterey Jack)
whyItWorks: A plain griddled flour tortilla filled with mild Monterey Jack cheese (naturally very low in lactose). Simple, easily absorbed carbohydrate and protein cushion when spicy or fibrous fillings cannot be tolerated.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Quesadilla sencilla de queso—plain, NO sour cream, NO pico de gallo, NO guacamole with onions.'
